'''Jenna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] residing on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] around [[3643 BBY]]. She informed [[Ellis (Ord Mantell)|Ellis]] that she saw her son [[Paul]] alive at [[Mannett Point]].
